# anthropic_workspace_rate_limit (Resource)

Manages a workspace's rate-limit overrides for one rate-limit group through the Admin API.

Each entry in `limits` sets the workspace's override for one limiter type
of the group. A limiter type that is not in `limits` keeps whatever value it
has, so this resource leaves overrides it does not manage alone. Removing a
type from `limits` clears its override, and destroying the resource clears
every override it manages, so the workspace inherits the organization's value
again. Manage each workspace and group pair with one resource only. An
import adopts every override the workspace has for the group.

The API stores a value above the organization's limit for the same limiter
type, but it enforces the lower of the two. A change takes effect within about
an hour. The API applies a change at once in its response, but a list made
right after can still show the previous value. For one hour after a write,
the provider keeps the written value while the list still shows the value from before
the write, so a refresh right after an apply plans no change. Any other value
shows as drift.

Use the `anthropic_rate_limits` data source to find a group's `rate_limit_id`
from a model name. Setting workspace rate limits is not available on Claude
Platform on AWS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_workspace" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

data "anthropic_rate_limits" "haiku" {
  model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
}

resource "anthropic_workspace_rate_limit" "production_haiku" {
  workspace_id  = anthropic_workspace.production.id
  rate_limit_id = data.anthropic_rate_limits.haiku.rate_limits[0].id

  limits = {
    tokens_per_day      = 5000000
    requests_per_minute = 500
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limits` (Map of Number) The workspace's override for each limiter type, from `0` to `9007199254740991`, keyed by limiter type. The API accepts `requests_per_minute`, `input_tokens_per_minute`, `output_tokens_per_minute`, `input_tokens_per_minute_cache_aware`, `tokens_per_minute`, `tokens_per_day`, `tool_uses_per_second`, `fast_itpmca` and `fast_otpm`. `fast_itpmca` and `fast_otpm` apply only to the groups where `anthropic_rate_limits` shows them. A `model_group` accepts every type except `tool_uses_per_second`, a `web_search` group accepts only `tool_uses_per_second`, and a `batch` group accepts only `requests_per_minute`. The plan fails when a known type does not suit the group, and warns about a type this provider does not know, which the API can still accept.
- `rate_limit_id` (String) The top-level `id` of the organization's rate-limit entry for the group, as `anthropic_rate_limits` returns it. This is not the `group_id` inside it. The ID differs between organizations.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<workspace_id>/<rate_limit_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_workspace_rate_limit.production_haiku wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ/rlt_01NwFawrTvAijwqn8AjKVBPS
```
